subject: english
question: **Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure**: The guests were being served refreshments by the host.

options.text: The host has served refreshments to the guests.
The host serves refreshments to the guests.
The host had been serving refreshments to the guests.
The host was serving refreshments to the guests.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The host was serving refreshments to the guests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **passive voice**: "The guests were being served refreshments by the host."
 
• To convert this sentence into the **active voice**, the subject (the host) must take the position of the doer of the action.
 
• The verb tense in the passive voice sentence is in the **past continuous tense** ("were being served"). Hence, in the active voice, the verb must also be in the past continuous tense ("was serving").
 
• Therefore, the correct active voice sentence is: **"The host was serving refreshments to the guests."**

Correct sentence: *The host was serving refreshments to the guests.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: "The host was serving refreshments."
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action. Example: "Refreshments were being served by the host."
 
• When converting from passive to active, always ensure:
 
 
• The doer of the action (subject) is clearly stated.
 
• The verb tense remains consistent.
